question: Select the synonym of **Relinquish**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Abandon**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Relinquish"** means to voluntarily give up something, especially a possession, claim, or right. (त्याग करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to relinquish her control over the project to allow others to take charge.
 
 
 
• **"Abandon"** means to give up completely or leave something behind. (त्याग देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He had to abandon the car due to mechanical failure during the trip.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Relinquish"** is **"Abandon"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Abandon**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maintain** (बनाए रखना): To keep something in existence or continue at a certain level.

 
 
• **Example:** He tries to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
 
 
 
• **Continue** (जारी रखना): To persist in an activity or process.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the students to continue their work quietly.
 
 
 
• **Retain** (रखना): To keep possession of something or hold onto it.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to retain her old books for future reference.
